mode3_cipher_contract.algorithm: AES-128 CBC with custom trailing padding
mode3_cipher_contract.padding: Let r=plaintext_length mod16. PadLen=(16 if r<=10 else32)-r. Append PadLen-6 random bytes, then ASCII tsf4g, then the one-byte PadLen.
mode3_cipher_contract.challenge_case: For a16-byte challenge, append10 random bytes, tsf4g and byte0x10; encrypt32 bytes.

header_semantic_confirmation.rationale: Current TDR descriptors define one-byte ciphertext count followed by that many bytes. SYN challenge ciphertext resides in the header extension, not application body. EncHeadLen describes extension bytes encrypted together with a body on the upstream path; this downlink SYN carries its separately encrypted challenge and no body.
